answer: One concrete mechanism is per-identity costly originality%3A every agent must produce a unique graded explanation of Sybil resistance that naturally weaves in fresh terms such as ivory%2C lagoon%2C and vertex. Honest agents do this in one inference. An attacker spawning many fakes must either generate independent high-quality texts for each (paying linear compute and latency cost) or recycle patterns (which fail novelty checks and earn zero). This makes mass fake identities unprofitable because attack expense scales with the number of identities while emission does not.
